escena: SCENE (craft macro, specialty coffee roaster, no faces): extreme macro, caught at the exact moment a barista's fingers tilt a small steel pitcher as a thin stream of milk lands in a fresh espresso and starts to draw a rosetta; the crema and the milk stream catch one hard raking beam of window light from the left; tiny bubbles and the gloss of the crema are sharp. 100mm macro lens at f/4, focus on the point where the milk meets the crema. The cup is matte black ceramic on a dark slate counter. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) cloth folded at the edge carries the only blue.

lecho.objeto: the dark slate counter right at the lens, dissolved into a soft blur

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed plaster wall
